definitions.explanation: The set of documents required when applying for a job, contest, grant, or program. Typically includes a resume, cover letter, and any additional required materials.

examples.japanese: {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
{応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧です。
examples.english: The deadline for application documents is next Friday.

examples.japanese: {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{選考|せんこう}→選考：03774_senkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象外|たいしょうがい}→対象外：10019_taishougai⟧となります。
examples.english: If there are deficiencies in the application documents, you will be excluded from the selection process.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧ (application, entry) and ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (documents, papers). A common compound in job hunting (⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧), scholarship applications, and contest entries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit application documents
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: application document deadline
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦{選考|せんこう}→選考：03774_senkou⟧: document screening (first stage of hiring)
- {応募書類|おうぼしょるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: deficiencies in application documents

- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: resume, CV — the standard Japanese-format resume
- ⟦{職務経歴書|しょくむけいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧: work history document — detailed career history, used alongside the resume
